Subject: Pilot runway — request for short top-up or credits

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our side: the engineering team ran a heavier set of tests than expected during the last week of the pilot and we’re going to exhaust the allocated minutes roughly 10 days earlier than planned. We still want to complete the final integration and a small stability run before a board demo.

Options that would work for us: a 2–3 week time extension on the current pilot OR a small credit bucket we can apply for the extra token usage + one day of hands-on engineering time from Redwood to help tune the prefix caching.

Can you send pricing for both options and any required paperwork? We have procurement involved on standby (cc’d). Ideally we’d like something that doesn’t require a full amendment if possible — a short addendum or a credit invoice would be best.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — demo is scheduled for 6/05 so we’re a bit time sensitive.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Platform Engineering
BlueHearth

Subject: Re: Pilot runway — request for short top-up or credits

Lena — thanks for the heads up and the clear options. We can do both; below are two practical paths and the trade-offs so you can pick quickly: 

1) Time-box extension (recommended for lowest friction)
- 3 week extension of the existing pilot environment
- No change to model variants or infra 
- Cost: incremental usage billed at 80% of list (20% courtesy discount) for the extension period
- Delivery: no DocuSign addendum required if PO issued referencing the pilot id, otherwise we’ll provide a 1-page addendum to sign
- Pros: preserves current telemetry continuity and makes the demo straightforward
- Cons: extends timeline which can delay procurement close

2) Credit + engineering day (recommended if you want to keep timebox end-date)
- One-time credit bucket equivalent to estimated 3-week overage (we can size after we review the attached usage csv)
- 8 engineering hours (remote) included to optimize prefix/KV cache and transient batching
- Cost: credit bucket invoiced at 70% of list ($V estimate after usage review) + fixed fee for 8 hours (or apply engineering hours from a committed ops block if you have one)
- Delivery: credit invoice + SOW for engineering day (simple 1-pg SOW)
- Pros: keeps original pilot end-date; gives you targeted ops help
- Cons: requires invoicing + small SOW 

I attached a quick usage summary template (pilot_usage_summary.csv) and a draft single-page addendum (redline-addendum-draft.pdf) to speed sign-off. If procurement prefers, we can issue a credit invoice that references DEAL-2026-1187 and skip a formal DocuSign route.

I’ll loop in Marissa for finance/discount guardrails and David on the engineering mechanics. If you want, we can lock option 2 today and I’ll send a final quote that procurement can PO against.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
